feeds.title: Everything Theatre
feeds.description: An honest & unpretentious guide to the London theatre scene. Reviews, competitions, features, opinions & podcasts that aim to make theatre appealing to all!

feeds.title: West End Wilma
feeds.description: West End Wilma prides herself on being an all-round theatre expert - from in depth and honest reviews to booking tickets online, where to sit and when to go. The blog features articles on interesting topics such as theatre etiquette and advice on booking tickets in various theatres, restricted view seats and what to avoid when trying to pick up budget tickets.

feeds.title: Glasgow Theatre Blog
feeds.description: The aim of the blog is to publicise and review arts events in Glasgow and the Greater Glasgow area. The best place for news, interviews and reviews of theatre in Glasgow, Scotland and beyond.

feeds.title: theatreCat
feeds.description: 'It seemed that honest vivid reviewing was a kind of duty: not merely a service to readers and potential ticket-buyers but to the art of theatre itself.' Written by former Chief Theatre Critic at The Times, Libby Purves, Theatre Cat is a wonderfully tight review blog.

feeds.title: Total Theatre » Writings
feeds.description: Founded in 1989, Total Theatre Magazine celebrates and supports a wide spectrum of contemporary theatre and performance, both nationally and internationally. Explore the theatre performances reviews, stories and history behind them and more!

feeds.title: UK Theatre Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a space for influential voices from the theatre sector to comment on topical issues, explore new ideas, highlight success stories, share expertise and more. UK Theatre is the UK's leading theatre and performing arts membership organisation. Our vision is to see a well-connected and well-supported theatre sector that is recognised as being at the heart of UK life, with thriving organisations, the world's greatest creative and managerial talent and ever-larger and more diverse audiences.

feeds.title: StagesideUK
feeds.description: StageSideUK is a blog about reviewing, critiquing and exploring the world of theatre, arts and performance.

feeds.title: Blackpool Grand Theatre
feeds.description: Keep up with the news and events at Blackpool Grand Theatre by checking out our fantastic blog. Blackpool Grand Theatre, built in 1894, this Victorian theatre seats 1,000 people and presents a wide selection of live entertainment.

feeds.title: The Bread & Roses Theatre
feeds.description: A 40- to 60-seat fringe venue above The Bread & Roses Pub, this intimate and versatile space boasts a wide variety of productions which bring in local and far-reaching audiences alike. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on performances and shows dates and schedules, critiques' opinions and more!

feeds.title: Theatre&Tonic Blog
feeds.description: Theatre & Tonic is a Midlands-based Theatre blog which covers the entire UK. The website also includes interviews and places to stay and eat when visiting the theatre. I'm Emmie & the founder of Theatre&Tonic. Established in 2014 as Carpe Diem Emmie, this blog grew from my university degree at Coventry University and is now edging towards a decade old. Over the years I have dipped my toes in Lifestyle & Travel blogging but it is theatre that I am passionate about.

feeds.title: Rewrite This Story
feeds.description: For all your theatre needs including news, reviews and interviews straight from the West End and beyond! Rewrite This Story is a stagey website, founded by Olivia Mitchell, that's dedicated to theatre of all types and everything that goes along with it. Olivia begun site in late 2015 as a place to share her thoughts on theatre just for fun. Since then, it has expanded and now includes a team of over 20 reviewers around the UK and even in Australia and the USA!

feeds.title: Creation Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Creation Theatre is the leader in the industry, creating shows that delight audiences. Our blog lets you go behind the scenes and into our work. We're Oxford's largest professional producing theatre company, specialising in digital, and site-specific inventive theatre in extraordinary locations. When the arts changed forever in the spring of 2020, we used our 20+ years of experience performing in unusual locations across Oxford and turned the innovation, creativity and adaptability that we are known for to making live digital theatre.

feeds.title: Musical Theatre Review
feeds.description: Covering everything from new writing at the grassroots of the industry to the latest red-carpet openings in the West End and on Broadway, the Musical Theatre Review spotlight falls on all aspects of professional musical theatre.

feeds.title: The Family Stage » Reviews
feeds.description: The Family Stage started as a personal blog charting the lives of a London-based family of four. Born out of Mummy's indecision over whether to become a theatre blogger or mummy blogger, it originally attempted to straddle the boundary between the two worlds. But with family life revolving around performing arts classes, and most of our spare time spent at the theatre, things became distinctly stagey pretty quickly. This is now very much a fully-fledged theatre blog, featuring all things theatrical. Check out the reviews of the theatre and musicals we have watched.

feeds.title: Fairy Powered Productions
feeds.description: Fairy Powered Productions is a website that reviews and discusses all things theatre. It has a blog section with articles on a variety of topics, including reviews of current productions, interviews with actors and directors, and news about the theatre industry. The website also has a forum where users can discuss theatre-related topics.

feeds.title: British Theatre Guide podcast
feeds.description: Interviews and more from the world of professional theatre right across the UK.

feeds.title: University of Bristol Blog
feeds.description: The University of Bristol Blog is all about its theater collection blogs. The University is globally renowned for the high quality of its teaching and its leading-edge research. Here you can field articles on plays like Starting with 3D Data: A 3D Data Book Sprint, Making a Scene, Act III- by Harriet Wilson, Heritage Participation Producer, Bristol Old Vic, and many more!

feeds.title: West End Theatre
feeds.description: The latest London theatre news, including new West End, shows coming to London, stars, and talent performing on the West End stage, plus photos and videos of London show West End reviews, and more! We're one of the greatest concentrations of entertainment venues, historic landmarks, restaurants, and shops in the world and feature over 40 major theatres, 30 museums, and galleries, and over 2,500 restaurants & bars.

feeds.title: Digital Theatre+ Blog
feeds.description: Digital Theatre+ provides powerful ways to connect English and Drama students with dramatic texts, poetry, and performance. On our blog, you can find all the latest news, teaching tips, topics & trends, events, and more!

feeds.title: The Theatre Times
feeds.description: The Theatre Times is the largest global theatre portal and publishes news stories on daily basis from a variety of sources. Our goal is to create a transnational discursive space that would bring together theatre-makers and theatre lovers, facilitating global collaborative models, and generating opportunities for interaction and creative development amongst a wide network of international theatre-makers and theatergoers.

feeds.title: Theatre Fan
feeds.description: Receive all the theater news, views, and reviews by Shaun Tossell! This blog is all about theatre, where he reviews all his favorite and good plays. His main love is musical theatre but then nothing beats a good play once in a while.

feeds.title: Birds of Paradise Theatre Company Blog
feeds.description: Scotland's touring theatre company promotes disabled artists and supports the arts sector. We aim to employ disabled and non-disabled actors and other theatre professionals, commission new work, work in partnership with other organizations at home and abroad, create positive images of inclusion, and encourage participation in the arts.

feeds.title: Carl Woodward
feeds.description: Covers the latest updates about theatre, opinion, industry news, & more.

feeds.title: Theatre Things Blog
feeds.description: Theatre Things is a blog all about theatre, pretty much what the name suggests. Here you can find reviews and random musings from a lifelong fan. Our blog has all the theatre news, reviews, and interviews from London, Kent, and around the UK. All my reviews are written not as a critic but simply as a member of the audience, who loves theatre and wants to support it.

feeds.title: Rev Stan's theatre blog
feeds.description: Love going to the theatre, here you'll find interviews, reviews, thoughts and experiences from London's theatre scene including big West End plays right down to fringe and pub performances.

feeds.title: Theatretrain Blog
feeds.description: The Theatretrain Way: training by industry-leading expert Kevin Dowsett. The Theatretrain Way is a more immersive and creative process that is closer to a theatre experience rather than school. Get all the updates, news, and information on blogs and events on our blog!

feeds.title: North West End UK
feeds.description: North West End UK was formed in 2015 to promote both amateur and professional theatre on an equal footing. Our team comprises of actors, directors, producers, and passionate theatre fans. Registered OffComm assessors. We review the best of amateur and professional theatre across the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Ardent Theatre Company Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts and discussions from behind the scenes on Ardent Theatre Company Blog. We are committed to producing theatre that speaks about the world we live in; both newly commissioned writing and established text with contemporary relevance. We work with non-theatre organizations that share similar ambitions to take a sector-wide approach to give voice to those who struggle to be heard.

feeds.title: Stagestruck Blog
feeds.description: Stagestruck Blog is a blog about a theater play by Rick Bowen. He has been reviewing amateur and professional theatre in Trafford and Manchester for more than 25 years and he has had the pleasure to interview many of the leading lights of the acting world. His aim with this site is to celebrate Greater Manchester's vibrant theatre by bringing you honest and entertaining reviews of the area's many varied productions.

feeds.title: Tom Bolton Theatre Blog
feeds.description: The Tom Bolton Theatre blog provides insightful reviews and commentary on various theatre productions, highlighting performances, storytelling techniques, and cultural impacts, with a particular focus on contemporary theatre and artistic expressions.

feeds.title: Society for Theatre Research Blog
feeds.description: The Society for Theatre Research serves all those interested in the history and technique of British and British-related theatre: academic and independent scholars, researchers, performers, other theatre workers, and of course theatergoers. Here. you can find information about all the Theater plays.

feeds.title: Chris Neville-Smith's Blog On Theatre
feeds.description: Welcome to Chris Neville-Smith's blog on Theatre where I provide reviews of stuff that's good. I write about local productions that are good or at least show some promise. I seek out plays that aren't already getting attention from other publications.

feeds.title: The Play's the Thing UK
feeds.description: The Play's the Thing UK aims to cover a wide range of performance genres and styles, with a focus on small-scale and fringe theatre. This is the lifeblood of UK theatre and performing arts, but it is also the work least likely to receive newspaper reviews. The Play's the Thing UK wants to provide small and emerging companies with the coverage they need and deserve, and publish those reviews alongside those of larger companies and venues.

feeds.title: Run Riot
feeds.description: Find listings and features on London's alternative scenes, including Art, Club, Dance, Film, Music, Theatre, Think & Wild Cards. Here you'll find out about the latest shows in town and try something a little bit different.

feeds.title: Stage Review
feeds.description: Stage Review reports what's happening in regional and London theatre. News, previews, features, interviews and those all-important reviews of professional productions.

feeds.title: Diary of a Londoness Blog » Theatre
feeds.description: Get the London lowdown on all the latest West End and regional theatre reviews. I'm Scarlett and this is my London blog - Diary of a Londoness. Walk with me through the streets of London and beyond, and experience what it's like to live in the world's culture capital. Diary of a Londoness includes outings to museums and galleries, the theatre, cinema and opera, as well as where to eat, drink, shop, and what to do with the little darlings. I like to travel, so I sometimes pen my adventures abroad.

feeds.title: Solomon Theatre Company Blog
feeds.description: Solomon has continued to bring to life serious issues young people through the use of great drama. We offer shows that focus on drugs, alcohol, law, crime, gangs, relationships, and sexual exploitation, as a way to communicate, educate and re-educate the severity to schools across the UK. We believe drama is a great medium to use to convey strong messages that promote change, healthy schools, and healthy lifestyles.

feeds.title: Theatre Bee
feeds.description: Love London theatre but hate the prices? Look no further. Welcome to Theatre Bee's ultimate guide to cheap theatre tickets in London. It also features reviews of the latest West End and fringe shows

feeds.title: Haywire Blog
feeds.description: Haywire is a company devoted to the extraordinary ordinary. At its core, our work is entirely obsessed with the character, with the human, the relatable, and the understandable behaviors that make up a piece of performance. The blog has all the news, interviews, and information related to theater.

feeds.title: Metta Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Metta is a London and Somerset-based theatre company founded in 2005 by writer/director P Burton-Morgan & designer William Reynolds. We tell political stories with imagination & make compelling theatre using all the story-telling tools at our disposal. Here on our blog, you can find information, news, interviews, and more about different theater plays.

feeds.title: At The Theatre
feeds.description: The National Theatre Review Website, where you can find all the latest theatre reviews and breaking news, features, star interviews, UK theater highlights, National Tour & West End reviews, news & spotlights, is 100% Independent and full-time.

feeds.title: West End World
feeds.description: Theatre Blog by Holly Smith (a Social Media Influencer and TV Presenter best known for appearing on ITV's This Morning). The blog is dedicated to musical theatre with helpful reviews, show guides, and more.

feeds.title: All The Arts Blog
feeds.description: Our Blog has all the art theater school news, events, and features. All The Arts Theatre School offers Award Winning affordable yet professional classes in the Bexley, Bromley, Eltham & Sidcup areas.

feeds.title: BritishTheatre.com
feeds.description: The latest Theatre Shows, Tickets, News & Guides: British Theatre is the best website for London West End theatre tickets, Off West End and touring theatre around the UK. The British Theatre website has been established to celebrate the rich and diverse theatrical culture of the United Kingdom. Our ethos revolves around encouraging and nurturing the performing arts in all its forms.

feeds.title: There Ought To Be Clowns
feeds.description: There Ought to be Clowns is a brilliant place to find reviews of plays, musical theatre, TV and film, describing itself as a 'theatrical diary' which actually turns out to be a very accurate description. There Ought to be Clowns is a very carefully thought out theatrical journal, with top notch reviews and a deeper look into both TV and film as well as on stage productions.

feeds.title: My Theatre Mates
feeds.description: MyTheatreMates.com pulls together the best theatre content from independent theatre journalists and bloggers, starting with co-founders Mark Shenton and Terri Paddock. It also runs the online Also Recognised Awards, celebrating disciplines and talent overlooked by other awards bodies. Follow this blog for Theatre comment, reviews and recommendations and more.

feeds.title: National Theatre
feeds.description: The National Theatre of Great Britain strives to be a national center of theatrical arts, central to the creative life of the country and unmatched in the world for scale, range of repertoire, and audience reach. Follow our blog for the drama, live shows on Southbank, touring nationwide streaming worldwide, and more!

feeds.title: Belgrade Theatre
feeds.description: Belgrade Theatre blog page offers all its latest stories filtered by family, funding, NPO, and more! The Belgrade offers an exciting mix of entertaining and engaging live experiences all under one roof. We aim to entertain, inspire and unleash creativity in Coventry and beyond.

feeds.title: LondonTheatre1 » Theater News
feeds.description: Here you can find all the latest theater news and reviews. London theatre news for London West End, Off-West End, and UK touring productions. News, reviews, interviews, tickets, production, and rehearsal images.

feeds.title: New Wolsey Theatre
feeds.description: The New Wolsey Theatre's mission is to create, develop and produce a vital and dynamic program of theatre, and other live performances and projects, for all the people of Suffolk and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Amy Stutz | UK Arts, Culture and Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Amy Stutz. This is my arts and culture blog that showcases and champions the best in theatre and cultural travel with a strong focus on the arts.

feeds.title: Last Minute Theatre Tickets » London Theater
feeds.description: All the London Theater news, reviews, tickets, and more! www.LastMinuteTheatreTickets.com is an independently owned business that provides theatre tickets for London West End theatres through booking links from our ticket supplier Encore Tickets which is a member of STAR. We also offer tickets for attractions, events, dinner and show offers, and hotel theatre breaks.

feeds.title: THEATRESS
feeds.description: A UK Theatre and Culture blog based in the Midlands & London. I started Theatress as a way to talk about something I loved. Theatre is an escape, a chance to be transported to another world, to be completely immersed in a story for 3 hours. There is something truly special about the theatre and there is nothing better than sharing that with others!
